title: HK AEFI Fund Closure Confirmed
subtitle: The Hong Kong AEFI Fund was officially closed on December 23, 2025, verified independently.
key_concept: The closure of the HK AEFI Fund marks a significant administrative event with implications for vaccine injury compensation.
visual_metaphor: A dark cathedral door with an amber 'CLOSED' seal, geometric ironwork, and a ledger book with a final entry date.
why_it_matters: Represents a systemic shift in vaccine injury policy, closing a chapter of compensation and potentially altering future claims.
zone_change: New domain: vaccine injury compensation landscape changed; fund closure is a border-crossing event.
